verdict.rationale: The evidence shows Vanta helps customers collaborate with auditors and offers an Auditor API that audit firms use to run engagements inside Vanta. Nothing documents booking an audit through Vanta, a vetted auditor network or marketplace, an in-house audit arm, or published timeline expectations. Auditor collaboration tooling is an adjacent feature, not the capability this story asks for.

support.subject: As a founder, I can book the audit itself through the vendor — a vetted auditor network or in-house audit arm with published expectations on timeline
